name: Livebook
description: Targeted retained-source read supports the narrow Tier A behavior for this primary application updater: Livebook checks for updates on boot, prompts before download/install, and invokes tauri-plugin-updater download_and_install after user confirmation; the Tauri config supplies the pinned key.
limitations: The retained snapshot does not establish current released artifact signing or deployment state beyond the checked-in pinned key/configuration.
Framework verification depends on the packaged updater implementation where the application delegates to Sparkle or tauri-plugin-updater.
